purpose: Data contract for future Google Ads Data Manager enhanced-conversions-for-leads export. This file is a schema only and contains no applicant records.

recommended_rows.meaning: Applicant was contacted and confirmed to meet the recruitment screening criteria.
Applicant progressed to employment after training.

export_fields.name: lead_key
export_fields.description: Stable internal application/lead identifier used for deduplication.

export_fields.name: conversion_time
export_fields.description: Timestamp for the real offline stage transition.

export_fields.name: gclid
export_fields.description: Google Click ID when collected with valid measurement consent.

export_fields.name: gbraid
export_fields.description: Google click identifier when applicable and collected with valid measurement consent.

export_fields.name: wbraid
export_fields.description: Google click identifier when applicable and collected with valid measurement consent.

export_fields.name: normalized_phone_hash
export_fields.description: SHA-256 of the normalized first-party phone number, generated in the controlled CRM/export layer only after the appropriate consent and legal basis are satisfied.

export_fields.name: source_campaign
export_fields.description: Internal campaign reference for reconciliation, not a replacement for Google attribution identifiers.

privacy_rules: Never commit real applicant rows, phone numbers, email addresses, hashes, GCLIDs or conversion uploads to the public repository.
Do not place applicant PII in URLs, UTM parameters, dataLayer events or page markup.
Advertising click identifiers are stored persistently only when measurement consent is granted.
Hashing and Data Manager export should occur in a controlled server-side or CRM workflow, not in public client-side source code.

deduplication.rule: Do not upload the same real-world stage transition more than once.
